caption:
Haven't filed your ITR yet: can you lose a ₹20,000 refund after 31 December?

For FY 2025-26, a late (belated) return can still be filed until 31 December 2026.
Late fee: ₹5,000 if your total income is above ₹5 lakh. Your refund is still paid.
After 31 December, only an updated return is possible, and it can only add tax: a refund can't be claimed through it.
Illustrative: ₹20,000 of extra TDS you never get back.

What's stopping you from filing: documents, time or the late fee?
Send this to the friend who still hasn't filed.

Sources: an income-tax filing site's guide on belated returns; a personal-finance magazine's explainer on belated filing (Aug 2026). Illustrative only.

For education only. Not investment advice.
